title: OAS lockfile (oas-lock.json)
description: Scope-local lockfile. lockfileVersion 3 records BOTH levels of the materialization model: `packages` locks the transport unit (exact source + commit + selected root + payload integrity + package-identity dependencies) and `capabilities` locks the installed entity (the materialized artifact under .agents/capabilities/installed/<id>/, its provider package, its dedicated manifest path inside that package, its artifact integrity, and its executable trust). lockfileVersion 2 (package store) and lockfileVersion 1 (per-capability marketplace locks) remain READABLE for diagnosis and explicit migration; neither is written any more, and neither is normalized or repaired on read. A lock never advances silently on restore.

oneOf.title: lockfileVersion 3 — package provenance + materialized capability identity

packages.description: Map of package identity → exact provenance of the transport unit for the full dependency closure at this scope. A package row proves WHERE the bytes came from; it does not describe an installed directory (there is no persistent package store in v3). The capabilities a package supplies are read off the `capabilities` map's `package` back-reference, so the two levels can never disagree.

source.description: Normalized acquisition source, in EXACTLY the writer's grammar: git:<url>@<ref>, path:<absolute-dir>, catalog:<id> for an originally bare catalog request, or catalog:<id>@<selector> for an originally explicit selector (the resolved commit is separate; official catalog identity grants no executable trust). It never carries a "#<path>" fragment — the selected package root is the entry's own "path" field. Parsed strictly: a payload that merely starts with a known scheme but is not valid for that kind (catalog:../evil, path:relative/dir) is an invalid lock, because update and the locked-template reader re-derive a source spec from this string and would reclassify it.

path.description: Canonical, repository-relative path of the SELECTED package root inside the source (the directory carrying oas-package.json). "." is the canonical spelling of the source root; git/catalog sources default to "oas-package" when the source contract selects nothing; path: sources are exact directories and always record ".". Never normalized or repaired on read — a non-canonical spelling is an invalid lock. Only `oas update` may change it.

commit.description: Exact git commit the package was acquired at (40-hex). For path: sources this is the string "local".

integrity.description: sha256 tree hash of the validated package PAYLOAD (the selected package root as fetched, before capability projection). It proves the exact distribution bytes and is what bare restore re-verifies before reprojecting. Materialized node_modules are excluded here — a capability's runtime closure is part of its own materialized artifact integrity.

dependencies.description: Package identities of direct dependencies (each present in this lock's packages map). Package-identity references only — never source strings.

capabilities.description: Map of capability ID → the materialized installed entity at .agents/capabilities/installed/<id>/. Every entry names the package that supplied it; that package MUST be a key of this lock's `packages` map.

version.description: Version from the capability's own oas.json (independent of the provider package's version).

package.description: Identity of the provider package; must be a key of this lock's `packages` map.

path.description: Canonical, package-relative path of the capability's DEDICATED root inside the provider package — the directory carrying its oas.json. Records exactly what was projected, so a package that moves a capability root is visible as a change. "." is only valid for a legacy (0.19, `configs`-spelling) package whose capability root is the package root; newly authored packages use dedicated roots such as "capabilities/<slug>".

integrity.description: sha256 tree hash of the MATERIALIZED capability artifact — every byte under .agents/capabilities/installed/<id>/, including its generated .oas-installation.json provenance file and its materialized runtime closure (node_modules). This is the only thing executable trust binds to.

trusted.description: Whether this capability's executable surface (commands/hooks) is approved at exactly this artifact integrity. Reset to false whenever the artifact integrity changes. Official catalog identity never grants it; a package-level approval does not exist.

oneOf.title: lockfileVersion 2 — package store (readable for diagnosis and migration only)

packages.description: Map of package identity → exact lock entry for the full dependency closure at this scope, as written by 0.19 into .agents/packages/installed/. Never written by this kernel; `oas migrate` projects it into v3.

integrity.description: sha256 tree hash of the installed package root.

depsIntegrity.description: sha256 digest of the materialized runtime dependency closure under the installed package root.

trustedCapabilities.description: Capability IDs whose executable surfaces were approved at exactly this package integrity. Subset of capabilities.

capabilities.description: OPTIONAL legacy v1 capability-lock residue retained by 0.19 staged migration. Same entry shape as lockfileVersion 1. v3 has no residue container: a scope carrying residue converts only when every residue entry converts too.

oneOf.title: lockfileVersion 1 — legacy per-capability marketplace locks (readable for migration only)
